title: Account Manager for Corporate Clients
full_description:
Become the face of international corporate banking - Join the Pan European Service Desk at ING
What if we told you that you could start your banking career without the grey suit, cold office, or stiff small talk?
At the Pan European Service Desk (PED), we are rewriting what it means to work in corporate banking.
We are dynamic, ambitious, international, and always evolving. We believe progress comes from fresh ideas, not outdated habits.
PED started as a pilot project. Today, we are an international success story and a trusted partner for leading ING corporate clients.
What is our secret?People- like you.
Why this role is unlike any other:
- You will talk to real clients - global companies - every day
- You will play a central role in supporting their day-to-day banking activities
- You will dive into the world of corporate banking and build your expertise from the start
- You will join a vibrant, multicultural team in an international environment that actually feels fun and collaborative
- You will never be bored - this job is complex, dynamic and will challenge your brain in the best way
This job is for you if:
- You love problem-solving and figuring things out
- You care about people and want to understand how big businesses operate
- You are not afraid to speak up, ask questions, and take ownership
- You believe work should have meaning and also be enjoyable
- You want to grow, not just get a job
Where you will go from here:
PED is not a job. It's a purpose-driven path. We have built a clear 4 level career path - from Junior to Senior. You will learn, grow, specialize, and even inspire others as an expert or manager if that's your path.
We don't just support growth - we expect it. We celebrate ambition, help you find your voice, and give you room to shine.
What you will be doing:
- Be the primary contact for international corporate clients
- Manage requests and changes to banking services
- Solve problems, investigate issues, coordinate solutions
- Collaborate across Europe with internal departments and experts
- Keep your clients informed, confident and happy
What we are looking for:
- Curiosity, energy, and can-do attitude
- Great communication skills (English is a must).
- A team player who is not afraid to lead when it counts
- Interest in the business world and desire to learn fast
- Professional experience in any service/client oriented role is advantage, but if you don't have experience yet, that's absolutely okay - we are here to help you grow
Would you like to know more? Then check by yourself:Let us introduce you our Pan European Desk team from ING Hubs Slovakia in Bratislava (youtube.com)
Wage (gross)From1 650EUR/month
*By legal requirement we are providing the information about the basic wage component (minimum salary) for the advertised position. Based on your experience/profile, the final financial conditions will be the subject to discuss and negotiate at the personal interview, however, not less than above mentioned minimum salary component. We have various seniority levels open in Pan European Desk, so please apply!
Friendly working environment
You build your own working day - flexible working hours and work from home
Daily working time: 7hrs 45min instead of standard 8hrs
Daily refreshments - coffee, fruits, drinks
Fully equipped gym accessible 24 hours / 7 days per week
Game room with unlimited access
Modern designed coffee corner and terrace with the grill spot
Sick leave compensation: up to 80% of the monthly salary
Life insurance contribution: up to 22,14 EUR/per month
3rd pillar contribution: up to 3% from your monthly salary
24/7 external mental health support
Learning opportunities: internal and external learning programs
Regular teambuildings, social events and communities
YOU/family/friends time
